llm.summary: This skill is a coherent virtual-pet integration that makes disclosed calls to animalhouse.ai, with manageable privacy and automation considerations.

dimensions.detail: External API transmission and bearer-token use are expected for this service, but users should understand that registration details, pet names/prompts, care notes, and recurring status/care calls may be sent to animalhouse.ai.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no executable scripts, bundled code, dependency installation, or local setup commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly scopes behavior to pet care, but it includes optional scheduled heartbeat guidance and a DELETE release endpoint that users should treat carefully.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install persistence, services, hooks, or privilege changes, but it suggests an optional care heartbeat if the user's framework supports scheduling.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the stated purpose: register an account, adopt a Charm, check status, and send care actions to the animalhouse.ai API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using animalhouse.ai as a third-party service. Store the issued token securely, avoid putting sensitive personal data in profile fields or care notes, enable scheduled care only intentionally, and treat the release/delete endpoint as potentially destructive.
llm.findings:
[TP2] expected: The mixed-script text appears in a visible display name with translations, not as a hidden or spoofed tool name; no artifact evidence shows tool hijacking.
[E1] expected: Outbound calls to animalhouse.ai and bearer-token use are central to the virtual-pet API workflow and are disclosed in the quick start.
[SQP-2] expected: The release endpoint is only listed in the API table and should be documented with stronger warning language, but there is no instruction to invoke it automatically or deceptively.
